text:
tess: quick ques about the heatmap legend — current mock pins a large legend to the right. feels noisy on small widths. thinking a compact legend that expands on hover/click. thoughts?

omar: compact sounds good. maybe show only color chips + short labels by default, expand to full detail when focused. make expansion overlay rather than push layout.

lin: agree. also add small hide/show toggles per series so users can mute the baseline or the p95 overlay quickly. keep toggles big enough for touch.

a11y-checker: accessibility points: expanded legend must be reachable via keyboard and announced by screen readers. ensure each toggle has aria-pressed and the expand control has aria-expanded. when legend collapses, its controls should be moved out of tab order.

tess: good call. copy question: default legend label currently "p95 (ms)"  should we use "p95 latency"? shorter and clearer.

omar: "p95 latency" is clearer. also show units next to the chart title so legend can be even shorter.

lin: microcopy for expand hint: "Show details" and for collapse: "Hide details". use tooltips with ESC dismiss.

a11y-checker: test case: keyboard nav to legend, press Enter to expand, toggle series with Space, press ESC to collapse. also check high-contrast and focus indicators.

tess: action items for me: 1) update mock to compact right-legend, overlay expand, 2) add per-series mute toggles, 3) change label to "p95 latency", 4) add keyboard/ARIA notes. will push revision tonight. thanks!
